# Test fixtures

Real-world input files for the palette parsers (`docs/03-data-model.md` §3):
`.hex`, `.gpl`, `.pal` (both JASC and RIFF), and Paint.NET `.txt`.

Parsers land in Phase 1 (`docs/08-roadmap.md`).

**Use hand-written or clearly-licensed files.** Fixtures are committed, so an
artist-made Lospec palette dropped in here is a licensing problem exactly as it
would be in `assets/palettes/` (`docs/07-tech-stack.md` §8). A three-color file
that exercises the parser is worth more than a real 64-color one anyway.
